items.headline: Evaluation reports become a launch requirement
items.whatChanged: A platform vendor now blocks agent launches without a signed evaluation report [sample-news-01], and teams treat failing eval suites as release blockers [sample-news-06].
items.whyItMatters: TPMs are the people who run launch gates, and postings already ask candidates to define evaluation and red teaming gates [sample-jd-03][sample-jd-04].

whatToDo.learn: Build a 20-question eval set for any chatbot and track pass rate across two prompt versions.
whatToDo.resumeAngle: Describe a quality gate you owned: what you measured, the threshold, and a launch you held or shipped because of it.
whatToDo.interviewQuestion: How would you decide that an AI feature is ready to launch?

items.headline: Consent rules reach AI training data
items.whatChanged: A regulator says training AI on user data requires explicit consent [sample-news-04], and new AI risk assessments must cover personal data [sample-news-02].
items.whyItMatters: Privacy program experience is already a common requirement in TPM postings [sample-jd-02][sample-jd-03], and AI makes it more central.

whatToDo.learn: Map one AI feature's data flow: what personal data it touches, the consent basis, and retention.
whatToDo.resumeAngle: Show a privacy or compliance program you drove across teams, with the regulation and the number of markets.
whatToDo.interviewQuestion: Walk me through how you would get an AI feature through privacy review in multiple countries.

items.headline: Model risk documentation moves before release
items.whatChanged: New rules require a documented risk assessment before a model reaches customers [sample-news-02], and a standards body published a checklist for running an AI management system [sample-news-08].
items.whyItMatters: Postings ask TPMs to run AI governance reviews and model documentation [sample-jd-15], work that sits between engineering, legal, and policy.

whatToDo.learn: Read a published AI management system checklist and draft a one-page launch review template from it.
whatToDo.resumeAngle: Frame a cross-functional review you ran (security, privacy, legal) as a governance process with clear gates.
whatToDo.interviewQuestion: How would you set up an AI review process that does not slow every launch down?
